# Ember Storybook fixture

This fixture was generated by Ember CLI 5.12 and uses the exact dependency tree
in `package-lock.json` (including Ember 5.12.0, Storybook / @storybook/ember
9.1.20, @storybook/ember-cli-storybook 0.6.1 and ember-template-imports 4.3.0).
It was built with Node 26.12.1. The adapter generates `.storybook/preview-head.html`
from the Ember build. From the repository root:

```sh
mise exec -- cargo run -- check tests/fixtures/ember/app/components --framework ember --generate
cd tests/fixtures/ember
npm ci
STORYBOOK_NAME=storymesh-ember-classic npx ember build --environment=development
npx storybook build
```

The generated index should contain `components-hello--default`,
`components-hello-ts--default` and `components-card--default`. Serve
`storybook-static` locally and open the corresponding `iframe.html?id=...`
URLs. The components are a template-only `.gjs`, a template-only `.gts`, and a
colocated `.hbs` plus JS class. Remove generated stories before repeating.
This fixture covers the app resolver, not classic `app/templates/components`,
addons, route-dependent components, or components needing arguments.

All three generated stories were registered by the pinned build and rendered
in headless Chrome. The fixture enables the `ember-cli-babel` TypeScript
transform so the `.gts` component is included in the Ember application; this
setting transpiles TypeScript but does not type-check it.
